const FAILURE_NAMES
dataclass FindResult
  reference: Ref | None
class Local
  path(reference: Ref) -> str
dataclass Ref
  store: str
  digest: str
  size: int
  locator: str
class Refusal(ValueError)
  __init__(word, offset)
class Store
  name() -> str
  find(digest: str) -> FindResult
  place(digest: str, size: int) -> Ref
class Writable
  commit(reference: Ref) -> None
def decode(data)
def encode(v)
